Market today: The tech/chip sector faces a key test with Nvidia's upcoming earnings, which will gauge its reliance on hyperscalers. This creates significant uncertainty for your concentrated book.

Your holdings: SOXL (-54.66%, SELL) and SPAL (-41.86%, NEW) are deep in the red and leveraged, demanding immediate attention. SMH (-13.01%, TRIM) also shows a notable loss. Remember, margin amplifies these drawdowns.

Watch: Keep a close eye on Nvidia's earnings report for market direction. Also, monitor your leveraged ETFs for further decay and potential stop breaches.

Bottom line: Prioritize managing risk in your highly concentrated, leveraged positions ahead of major tech catalysts.
plays: SOXL is down -54.66% and marked SELL. Seriously consider trimming this leveraged position to reduce your high concentration and margin risk.
SPAL, a new leveraged ETF, is already down -41.86%. Watch its stop at 21.38 very closely; leveraged products decay and move fast.
SMH is down -13.01% and marked TRIM. Consider reducing exposure to this chip ETF to manage your overall sector concentration.
